title: Tractor
author: Grab3D
upstream_origin: Procedural Blender scripts with AI-assisted code; the retained upstream manifest states no generative AI geometry or textures.
processing: Rotate imported front +Z to -Z; uniformly fit the existing 2.35 x 2.35 x 3.6 m gameplay envelope, centre XZ and ground Y.

Generate LODs for physical source parts independently, select near geometry within 4,000 triangles, then merge identical complete material descriptions while retaining each part at every combined LOD.
Correct retained tyre contact samples by at most 0.04 m; derivative metadata records the observed maximum. No physics or collision data changes.
Retain normals, tangents and UVs; resize source PBR maps to 1K, generate mipmaps and save self-contained S3TC PortableCompressedTexture2D buffers.
scope: One static decorative tractor in the canonical default field; no vehicle controller or runtime authoring dependency.
